risks.risk: The drive gear teeth may be chipped or worn, leading to engine noise or failure.
risks.proof: High-resolution macro photos of the gear teeth surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: As a damaged unit requiring a rebuild.

risks.risk: The assembly may be a low-quality aftermarket replacement rather than genuine OEM.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped part number or manufacturer logo on the casting.

proof_requests: Photo of the 10-digit Toyota part number or any manufacturer logos stamped on the body.
Video showing the gears being turned to confirm the internal shafts rotate freely.
Close-up photo of the gear teeth to check for wear or pitting.
